# commander_enterprise_user (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up an enterprise user by email or ID. Returns the user's ID, name, email, job title, roles, teams, and status so you can reference them in other resources.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user` (String) Enterprise user email or ID to find the user.

### Optional

- `managed_company` (String) Managed company name or ID to scope the lookup (used for API context only; not returned in the result).

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) Email of the found enterprise user.
- `id` (String) ID of the found enterprise user.
- `job_title` (String) Job title of the found enterprise user.
- `name` (String) Name of the found enterprise user.
- `roles` (Set of String) Roles of the found enterprise user.
- `status` (String) Status of the found enterprise user.
- `teams` (Set of String) Teams of the found enterprise user.
